Package com.agrialert.alert_manager.notifications

Class AlertNotificationManager

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.alert_manager.notifications.AlertNotificationManager
public final class AlertNotificationManager extends Object
Handles alert notification channel creation and dispatching of alert notifications.

    • notifyNewAlerts

      @RequiresPermission("android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS") public static void notifyNewAlerts(android.content.Context context, List<Alert> newAlerts, Map<String,Integer> totalFieldsByGroup)
      Posts notifications for newly created alerts, aggregating notifications at group level when the majority of fields in a group have new alerts.

      Rule: if a group has more than one field and the number of distinct fields to notify is greater than 50% of the total fields in that group, then a single group notification is posted and per-field notifications for that group are suppressed.

      Parameters:
      context - any context used to build notifications
      newAlerts - list of newly created alerts
      totalFieldsByGroup - map of group name to total fields count
